name: lib/circuit-breaker
title: Circuit breaker
summary: Resilience4j-style breaker (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF_OPEN) harvested from mukoko-weather: a sans-IO sliding-window core with the time passed in, and an async wrapper. Per-provider tuning is a documented pattern (Tomorrow.io 3 failures / 5 min opens for 2 min; Open-Meteo 5 / 5 min opens for 5 min), not a preset list.

config.name: isFailure
config.rule: A predicate; a declined error releases a half-open probe slot and changes nothing else.

behaviour.rule: CLOSED admits. onFailure drops failures with now - t >= windowMs, records now, and opens (openedAt = now, failures cleared) when the count reaches failureThreshold: on that failure, not on the next call.

OPEN is observed as HALF_OPEN once now - openedAt >= cooldownMs (the transition is recorded at that first observation). Until then tryAcquire is rejected with retryAfterMs = cooldownMs - (now - openedAt).
HALF_OPEN admits while probesInFlight < halfOpenMaxCalls, else rejects with retryAfterMs 0. onSuccess closes (failures cleared); onFailure reopens (openedAt = now).
An outcome reported while OPEN (a call admitted before it opened) is ignored.
A rejection from an inner guard, or an error isFailure declines, releases a half-open probe slot and changes nothing else (onIgnored). A cancelled Rust call does the same.
The breaker applies no timeout of its own; passing timeoutMs is a config error (compose withTimeout).
Transitions {from, to, at} are kept, the most recent 64.
